claim: The maximum air temperature in Berlin on 2026-08-28 (UTC day) will be above 25.4°C.
resolution_criterion: YES if the value at JSON pointer /daily/temperature_2m_max/0 in the Open-Meteo response for latitude 52.52, longitude 13.41, start_date=2026-08-28, end_date=2026-08-28, timezone=UTC is strictly greater than 25.4. NO otherwise. The threshold was set to the forecast value published for 2026-08-28 at the time of writing, so the honest probability is close to a half.
